spec: §15 suite C; §4.6 qload/qunload inverses, qstore and qexchm self-adjoint pairs applied twice
derivation: The local region's image is all-zero; load then unload cancel, two stores of t cancel, two exchanges cancel, so memory is the identity: mut 2 stays 2 (key mut (0,1) then in (1,0) = 0110) and the region is back at its image.
